citations.title:
2.2K views · 127 reactions | Summer 2025 guiding on Mount Hood, the highest peak in Oregon (11,239 ft / 3,426 m), located just 80 km from Portland.

Mount Hood is one of the most popular glaciated peaks in the United States, with thousands of climbers attempting the summit every year. ￼

The standard south-side route from Timberline Lodge is the most commonly guided path. Although considered a “beginner” mountaineering peak, it still requires real alpine skills:
 • Use of crampons and ice axe
 • Glacier travel and crevasse awareness
 • Early alpine start (midnight–2 AM)
 • Steep snow and ice sections near the summit

Climbing season is best from April to mid-June, when snow conditions are stable and safer. ￼

A typical summit push is done in one long day,
